description: Georgia Opts into the Federal Tax Credit Program for School Choice. Governor Kemp has opted Georgia into the federal tax credit scholarship program for school choice, made possible by the passage of the One Big Beautiful bill last summer. Georgia has a tax credit program called Georgia Goal, and this will be in addition to it. Individual taxpayers can donate up to $1,700 to fund scholarships in exchange for a discount of the same amount on what they owe in federal taxes. These tax savings can be used on private school tuition and expenses. Tax Relief Bills Introduced. House Bills 1000 and 1001 are two priorities highlighted in Gov. Kemp’s State of the State address. HB 1000 would provide one-time tax relief by issuing a credit to individual taxpayers based on income taxes paid in recent years, and HB 1001would lower Georgia’s income tax rate to 5.19% to 4.99%. Chinese TikTok parent company strikes deal with US investors to avoid ban. Good news for consumer privacy and national security. American investors have finalized an agreement with ByteDance, the Chinese owner. This deal transfers US data and most operations to a new venture managed by several US tech firms.
